question: Kanav starts from point A and drives 11 km towards the east. He then takes a left turn, drives 7 km, turns left and drives 13 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 12 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 2 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Kanav starts from point A and drives 11 km towards the east.

He then takes a left turn, drives 7 km, turns left and drives 13 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 12 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 2 km and stops at point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4416cf7ab52bec91f19978a2ebc82a5df014582f459daae725d26efe7a50a30a.png] 

Thus, Kanav should drive 5 km (12 km - 7 km) in the north direction in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
